401892805.summary: Watch list game. Analysts and models favor Vegas: the moneyline runs about -204 to -222 (PuckCast's book table, Nov 27 morning), and the models give the Golden Knights 63.8% (PuckCast, VGK grade B), 64.6% (BetMGM) and 67% (Covers). Bang The Book and the FOX Sports/iHeart computer take the Vegas moneyline, UltimateCapper takes Vegas -1.5, and both published final scores are 4-3 Vegas. Vegas is 15-6-5 with five straight road wins; San Jose is 11-14-2, 42.7% in 5v5 expected-goals share (Vegas 53.2%) and lost 7-0 at Anaheim last time out. The split is on the margin and total: Covers' top pick is Under 6.5, BetMGM's model has the Sharks covering +1.5 (57%), FOX takes Sharks +1.5 and Parlae projects a coin flip. Carter Hart is expected for Vegas and Yaroslav Askarov for San Jose (neither confirmed); the Sharks are without Trouba, Sherwood and Chernyshov.

401892795.summary: No track: not a top-7 vs bottom-7 game (Boston is 8th in the consensus power rank; on the readout list for its 25 score). Boston is about -156 to -159 at home (CBS -156, MyBookie -159), and the betting pages lean Bruins: CappersPicks' AI projects 4-1 Boston, and BettingNews shows 83% of public bets and all listed experts on Boston. Toronto is 9-14-3 and went 1-8-1 before beating the Islanders 4-2, while Boston (15-8-1) is 2-4 since Nov 12 and allowed nine goals in its last two. The dissent is real: Covers takes Leafs +1.5 as Marchenko returns from injury, and UltimateCapper takes Toronto +145 on the moneyline. Stolarz is confirmed for Toronto (Daily Faceoff); Swayman is expected for Boston. Toronto remains without Domi and Merzlikins; Boston's Hagens (back) is listed to return Nov 27.
